evals.prompt: Create an OpenLayers map with MapTiler Streets v4 vector tiles styled using ol-mapbox-style.
evals.expected_output: A complete, valid HTML/JavaScript application using modular ES imports from the 'ol' package and 'ol-mapbox-style', importing ol/ol.css, initializing an ol/Map with target 'map', and calling apply(map, styleJsonUrl).

evals.prompt: Build an interactive OpenLayers digitization tool with Draw, Modify, and Snap interactions for polygon geometries.
evals.expected_output: A standalone web page importing ol/interaction/Draw, ol/interaction/Modify, and ol/interaction/Snap, attaching all three interactions to an active ol/layer/Vector with ol/source/Vector, and enabling magnetic vertex snapping.

evals.prompt: Create a high-performance OpenLayers point clustering map with animated zoom expansion on cluster click.
evals.expected_output: A complete page importing ol/source/Cluster, ol/layer/Vector, wrapping a point source in Cluster with a distance parameter, styling cluster circles and text labels with feature count, and zooming to the cluster extent on click.

evals.prompt: Implement a real-time split-screen layer swipe comparison between satellite imagery and streets basemap in OpenLayers.
evals.expected_output: A web application with two tile layers, an HTML range slider or mouse drag listener, using canvas precompose/prerender and postrender event clipping to render half of the viewport with satellite and the other half with streets.

evals.prompt: Render an enterprise Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) in OpenLayers with WebGLTileLayer and custom band calculation.
evals.expected_output: A standalone page importing ol/layer/WebGLTile and ol/source/GeoTIFF, configuring a COG source URL with normalize: true, and setting up dynamic client-side raster styling expressions.
